llama_llama_red_pajama.notes: Core emotional vocabulary (scared, cry, wait, hug) is especially important for this book as the story centres on separation anxiety at bedtime. 'Mama' is the child's primary communication target — llama calls for mama throughout. 'Red' was considered as a fringe word given the title, but the colour core button already covers colour labelling and the 11 slots are better used for narrative and emotional words. Existing activity_images already include llama, pajamas, bed, lamp, stairs, mama, dark — these can be reused directly.
